channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily curated opinion and blog posts from tech researchers and thinkers

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Fable 5.2 is the New Bazooka
item.description: When to reach for Anthropic's new top model over Opus 5.5 — a full benchmark rundown, including Fable 5.2 solving two open physics problems and a 1,000-agent team formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean in 30 hours.

item.title: Bruce Schneier: Usable Security at Luxury Hotels
item.description: A phishing case study from luxury hotels shows why "just don't click on links" is bad advice when answering strangers' emails is the job — and why split accountability between owner, operator, and brand leaves nobody responsible.

item.title: Scott Aaronson: More podcasts, conversations, talks
item.description: His updated "Are We Cooked?" talk on the AI Mathocalypse — open problems in math falling to AI faster than he can update the slides — plus conversations on quantum, consciousness, and why he says please and thank you to GPT.
